items.description: `await onFileUpload(file)` in the upload handler is not wrapped in try/catch, and `filesGetFileStatus` (upload-utils.ts:233) throws on a non-2xx response or network failure. A rejection skips both reset branches, leaving `isUploading: true` permanently and silently blocking Save (the submit guard checks both upload slots), with no way to recover short of switching submission method or reloading.

Uploading (or removing) a receipt-notice file alone now flips a Mailed-method case's `isSubmitted` flag, which drives workflow phase, beneficiary-facing status, and `case_waiting_for_government_entered` — with zero test coverage at any level (no widget test file, no e2e, and the backend spec only asserts event-firing given `isSubmitted=true` rather than the derivation logic itself).

Starting a receipt-notice upload while on the Mailed method and then switching submission method to Online mid-flight (the method Select was not disabled during upload) let the stale upload continuation re-set `receiptNoticeFileId` after the method change had already cleared it, so Save could persist `submissionMethod: Online` together with an abandoned receipt notice, which resurfaces if the user switches back to Mailed.

The migration file is timestamped May 13 while 76 migrations merged into main since then sort after it by filename, so a fresh-DB bootstrap would run this migration out of order relative to deployed environments. The DDL itself is order-independent, but the filename should be regenerated with a current timestamp before merge.

`receiptNoticeFileId` (like the pre-existing `proofOfSubmissionFileId`) was written straight to the FK from the request body with no check that the file belonged to the requesting user. Since that id then feeds `collectCaseFileIds`'s bulk-download allowlist with no further ownership re-check, any user with case-write access who knew a foreign file UUID could attach and download cross-case file content.

`null` clears the FK on update (via the global `ignoreUndefined: true` assign config) while `create` coerces `null` to `undefined`, and neither branch had a spec case for `receiptNoticeFileId` — the remove-then-save path (web sends `null`) was the most likely to regress silently without a test pinning it.

items.acceptance_evidence: Not accepted; author declined on the review thread (identifiers redacted).
items.description: The bulk-download allowlist branch and the folder-emission branch in `getProofOfSubmissionFolder` that decide whether a receipt notice passes bulk-download validation are untested — no doc-repo test exercises `collectCaseFileIds` or references `receiptNoticeFile` outside the proof-of-submission service spec.
